title.en: An Act Appropriating as Additional Appropriation for the Construction of the Pototan Public Library and Boy Scout Building in the Municipality of Pototan, Province of Iloilo, the Unexpended Balance of the Appropriation for the Construction of the Pototan Municipal Building Under Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1594_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item 2, subparagraph v, paragraph 4, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is amended to read as follows:
"(2) Pototan Municipal Building construction ₱80,000.00 "(2-a) Pototan Public Library and Boy Scout Building construction 20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
